# TheGenAI — AI Workshops, Proof-of-Value Sprints & Codebase Intelligence | Netherlands

> TheGenAI is an independent AI studio based in Amsterdam, founded in 2026 by senior engineer Dima Kalachniuk. We engineer custom enterprise AI solutions, reverse-engineer legacy codebases, deliver hands-on developer team workshops, and build working AI prototypes in an 8-hour proof-of-value sprint. We serve clients across Europe.

## Why Choose TheGenAI

- **Speed**: We deliver working AI prototypes in a single 8-hour proof-of-value sprint — proven by live platforms like Kerntest.nl and WhereToInvest.nl.
- **Principal-Led**: You work directly with a senior builder and architect — zero agency overhead or junior handoffs.
- **Enterprise-Ready**: Private cloud deployment (AWS, Azure, GCP VPCs), zero data retention, and EU AI Act-aware design.
- **Proven Track Record**: 50+ AI sprints & builds, 8+ live shipped products.
- **Workshops That Stick**: Hands-on training in AI-assisted coding and agentic workflows (AGENTS.md, llms.txt), plus organizational AI-literacy sessions.
- **Transparent Pricing**: Fixed pilot fees credited toward full follow-up engagements; 100% client code and IP ownership.

## Our Core Services

### 1. Legacy Codebase Intelligence (Flagship)
Turn undocumented legacy monoliths and tribal knowledge into living architecture maps, API contracts, module dependency graphs, and AI-ready documentation. Eliminates key-person risk, accelerates developer onboarding, and enables AI coding assistants (Antigravity, Cursor, Claude Code) to work safely with your code.
- **Price**: Pilot (1 module, ~1 week) from €5,500 fixed. Full codebase from €15,000.
- **Note**: Pilot fee is credited against a full engagement.
- **Security**: 100% Private, executed within your VPC or on-premise.

### 2. AI Readiness Scan
A 1-2 week scan that identifies your highest-value AI use cases, pinpoints technical and regulatory risks, and produces a prioritised roadmap. No hype, just an actionable plan.
- **Price**: €3,900 fixed.

### 3. Proof-of-Value Sprint (8 Hours)
A working prototype of your "magic feature" built in a single day, proving tangible value before major investment. Follow-up production hardening is available.
- **Price**: €2,900 fixed.
- **Deliverable**: Working prototype of your core feature and complete source code.

### 4. Production Hardening
Turn a prototype into robust software your engineering team can actually run: automated tests, security review, structured logging, CI/CD, and a clean handover.
- **Price**: €1,000/day or 5-day package €4,750.

### 5. AI Workshops for Developer Teams
Hands-on training in AI-assisted coding, working safely with agents (AGENTS.md, llms.txt), and building real prototypes. Includes an optional AI-literacy session for the wider organisation under the EU AI Act.
- **Price**: Half-day €2,000, full-day €3,500 (up to 12 people). AI-literacy session half-day €1,500 (up to 20 people).

### 6. Website as a Service (WaaS)
Bespoke, high-converting websites designed specifically for contractors, builders, and service firms in the Netherlands with zero upfront cost and all-inclusive maintenance.
- **Price**: Dedicated plans from €0 downpayment (€79.99/mo) or classic model (€399-€499 setup + €39.99/mo).

*Pilot fees are credited against follow-up work. 50% upfront, 50% on delivery.*

## Frequently Asked Questions

**Q: Can TheGenAI really build a prototype in 8 hours?**
A: Yes. By focusing on the core "magic" feature and leveraging pre-built components and AI-native development tools, we deliver high-quality, functional prototypes that prove value in a single session.

**Q: What happens after the 8 hours?**
A: You receive a working prototype of your core feature along with the complete source code. Production hardening — adding automated tests, CI/CD, security audits, logging, and production infrastructure — is a separate, scoped follow-up phase so you only invest once value is proven.

**Q: What do your services cost?**
A: We work with fixed, transparent pricing: AI Readiness Scan (€3,900 fixed), 8-Hour Proof-of-Value Sprint (€2,900 fixed), Legacy Codebase Intelligence (pilot from €5,500, full codebase from €15,000, with pilot fee credited toward full engagements), Production Hardening (€1,000/day or €4,750 for 5 days), and Developer Workshops (half-day €2,000, full-day €3,500). Website as a Service (WaaS) offers dedicated plans starting from €0 upfront.

**Q: Who owns the code?**
A: You do. The client owns 100% of the deliverables and custom source code, as agreed and stipulated in our contract. There is no vendor lock-in.

**Q: What is the AI-literacy session?**
A: The AI-literacy session is a half-day interactive workshop covering the AI-literacy obligation under the EU AI Act for organisations using or deploying AI systems. It provides practical, non-technical and technical guidance on safe, compliant AI usage.

**Q: How does TheGenAI handle enterprise data security, privacy, and EU AI Act compliance?**
A: We prioritize enterprise-grade security and full compliance with the EU AI Act and GDPR. All solutions can be deployed 100% privately within your enterprise VPC (AWS, Azure, GCP) or on-premise air-gapped environments. We enforce zero data retention policies with zero training on your proprietary data. Learn more on our Security and Data Handling page (https://thegenai.nl/security/).

**Q: How do you reverse-engineer and document undocumented legacy codebases?**
A: We employ specialized static analysis engines and private LLM agents to map service boundaries, data flows, database schemas, and API contracts into living architectural diagrams and OpenAPI specifications. We also create context layers (AGENTS.md, llms.txt) allowing modern AI coding assistants to work safely with your legacy code without hallucinations.
